title: Pointed factorization for the residue map
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-pointed-map, every ring homomorphism from the strict henselization ring to the relative separable closure satisfies the displayed factorization through all canonical neighbourhood legs.

proof.text: Construct the compatible map on the affine etale residue-triple colimit and transport it along the neighbourhood comparison.

lean.statement: theorem strictHenselizationPointedMap_factorization {Y : Scheme.{v}} {Ω : Type v} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (barY : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y) [Algebra (Y.residueField (barY (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω))) Ω] (hΩ : algebraMap (Y.residueField (barY (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω))) Ω = (Scheme.descResidueField (Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo barY)).hom) [IsLocalRing (Scheme.strictHenselizationRing barY)] : ∀ ψ : Scheme.strictHenselizationRing barY →+* separableClosure (Y.residueField (barY (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω))) Ω, (∀ j : SmallModel.{v} (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods barY), Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ((IntermediateField.val (separableClosure (Y.residueField (barY (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω))) Ω)).toRingHom.comp ψ)) ≫ (Scheme.strictHenselizationCone barY).π.app (Opposite.op (Opposite.op j)) ≫ (Spec (Opposite.unop ((equivSmallModel.{v} (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods barY)).inverse.obj j).1.left)).isoSpec.inv = ((equivSmallModel.{v} (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods barY)).inverse.obj j).2.left)
